snippet.title: Passionstruck - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
As Ilo, a mysterious, magical poet, you and your companion friends go and… take a break from saving the world?? However, what seems like a lovely day out at a local orchard turns into a step towards rescuing your home from a dangerous curse.

In Passionstruck, a story-heavy fantasy RPG, engage in fun dialogue, challenge foes in turn-based battles, and explore an unfamiliar colorful world as you uncover truths about things you cherish most.

AVAILABLE NOW for FREE on itch-io! https://im-pika-chan.itch.io/passionstruck
_________________________________________
Trailer music by Whoopz: https://bsky.app/profile/whoopz.bsky.social

Art, trailer, and game by Alice "Pika Chan": https://impikachan.carrd.co/
